seo.title: About X-Blog
seo.description: X-Blog is a modern tech blog system built with FastAPI + Nuxt, supporting Markdown, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, syntax highlighting and more.

about.intro1: X-Blog is a clean and elegant tech blog system built with modern frontend and backend technologies. We are committed to providing developers a lightweight, fast and beautiful blogging platform.
about.intro2: Whether sharing technical insights, keeping study notes, or posting project updates, X-Blog delivers an excellent writing and reading experience.
